name: Sustainable proportion (asset-level qualification for fund 70% threshold)

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraphs 4.23-4.27 — minimum 70% of fund assets must meet the credible sustainability standard for the Sustainability Focus label)

summary: PS23/16 requires ≥70% of fund assets to meet a credible sustainability standard for the Sustainability Focus label. At the project (asset) level, this criterion tests whether the asset would qualify toward the fund's 70% numerator. Asset-level qualification is binary: the asset either clears the credible-standard gates (c1 + c2 both aligned) and counts, partially qualifies (FMP discretion), or does not count. Fund-level 70% aggregation is the FMP's job; PB certifies the asset's eligibility status.
